concept: Hosting, domains and email as the sides on a cafe menu board, rendered in 3D (Blender). One plum felt letter board with push-in letters and an oak frame on a pale pink counter, shot from the left three ways, the words changing each time. Low and close: On the menu, your new website. Further back: Sides, hosting, domains, email, same kitchen. Then the foot of the board: To order, book a call, at nexulabs.co.uk, with the wordmark printed on the oak rail. Every word is a physical letter on the board; there is no type set over the picture. Plum felt, ivory letters, oak and one pink.
